title: UniPath Thailand bootcamp programme dataset
intended_use: Programme discovery, Python filtering and explainable preference matching.
course_status: Proposed 4-day, 12-hour bootcamp. Related source course: 06.A Web Master; this dataset is a new resource, not an existing Notion lesson.
coverage: Curated public-university examples in central, northern and southern Thailand. Not exhaustive or representative. No northeastern or private-university coverage in version 1.
display_name_policy: programme_en, programme_th, university_en, university_th and faculty_or_college are concise editorial display labels. official_title preserves a title observed in the cited source. Display labels are not guaranteed official translations.
matching_policy: Interest tags and summaries are teacher-authored proposals. A match means preference overlap only. Location and language are filters, not proof of admission eligibility. Do not use zero matches to conclude there are no suitable programmes in Thailand.
unknown_policy: null means not collected; unknown means not established or unresolved. Neither means zero, false, free tuition, no requirement or eligible.
language_policy: en/th identify main instruction using the stated evidence basis. th_en means bilingual. International format is not automatically English. Unknown languages must remain visible as unknown, with an optional include-unknown filter.
admission_policy: No admission criteria, test-score thresholds, chances, deadlines or total tuition have been extracted. Programme admission_url is an official reference only. A dated historical reference must display its year. Generic TCAS context does not establish which rounds any programme accepts.
